name: work-submission
description: Shared commit entry point and the single decision for how work reaches main (Revisor local PR / GitHub PR / direct main).
cardTemplate: Summarise the work-submission domain: the shared commit entry point and the submission route decision.
rationale: The workflow branch used to be copied into Castra hooks, the Cc API and skill documents; a stale copy either blocks the正規手段 or lets a GitHub push through. Cc owns the project registration, so the decision lives here and the hooks read it.
